findings.title: Mixed Chinese/Arabic quantity ranges and separated qualifiers still become exact quantities
findings.requirement: requirements.md: structured finite plans must use explicit values; missing/unsupported input must request rewriting, never guess. Quantity is one integer 1–100.
findings.impact: The original examples now reject. Real API still accepts mixed Chinese/Arabic ranges (十二台到13台 -> 13; 12台到十三台 ->12) and separate qualifiers (至少采购12台 / 约需12台 ->12). Same explicit-field/no-guessing requirement; no browser launch or demand effect.
findings.recommendation: Reject quantity qualifiers across the finite input and additional Chinese-number quantity expressions; do not count only Arabic numeric tokens.

findings.title: Cancel/revoke/negated-registration input produces a new procurement proposal
findings.requirement: requirements.md: 缺项/含不支持操作时请求改写，不猜测。 The finite workflow proposes synthetic procurement registration only.

findings.impact: Actual authenticated POST /api/propose returns HTTP 201 registration drafts for explicit cancellation/revocation/negation. It reverses the requested operation at the planning stage; human approval still gates effects, and the probe created no demands.
findings.recommendation: Fail closed for explicit non-registration or negated intent inside the supported finite-input grammar; do not reinterpret it as registration.
